title: echo-tool I/O schema
description: Input/output contract for tools/echo-tool/tool.py. Per Notion v4 §'Skill vs tool' — tools have explicit IO schemas. Top-level `input` and `output` are themselves valid Draft-07 sub-schemas, one for each side of the tool's contract.

message.description: The string to echo back. May be empty.

echoed.description: The message field from the input, echoed verbatim.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the tool ran.

input_keys.description: Sorted list of keys present in the input object (proves the tool inspected the input).
